info.title: uMailServer API
info.description:
REST API of uMailServer (source of truth: `internal/api/server.go`, `internal/api/admin.go`).

**Base path.** Everything JSON lives under `/api/v1` on the main HTTP listener (`http.port`, default 443; the process itself speaks plain HTTP on that listener and TLS is expected to be provided in front of it, cookies are marked `Secure` when the request arrived over TLS). A second, admin-only listener (default `127.0.0.1:8443`, `admin.*`) serves the admin SPA plus a subset of the admin routes (domains, accounts, queue, rate limits, metrics, stats, vacations list, push stats) and `/health`.

**Authentication.** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a JWT (HS256) in the body (non-browser clients) and sets an HttpOnly `jwt` cookie. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or let the browser send the cookie (cookie wins when both are present). Public endpoints are marked `security: []`. Admin-only operations are labelled and answer 403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` to ordinary users. The admin listener accepts Bearer tokens only (no cookie) and reports auth failures as `{"error","message","code"}`.

**Request rules (all unsafe methods under `/api/v1/` except login, logout and `/api/v1/account/*`).** `Content-Type: application/json` is mandatory even for body-less DELETE/POST (400 `Content-Type must be application/json`). Cookie-authenticated requests with an Origin/Referer from another host are 403. JSON bodies reject unknown fields (400). Default body cap 4 MB (26 MB for mail send/draft); oversize bodies surface as 400, not 413.

**Errors.** `{"error": "<message>"}` with the HTTP status. Methods other than those documented answer 405 with an `Allow` header; HEAD is answered for GET routes.

**Rate limiting.** Per client IP, 1-minute window, `security.rate_limit.http_requests_per_minute` (default 120, 0 disables), applied to the protected `/api/v1/` routes and logout; exceeded -> 429 with `Retry-After: 60`. Login has its own failure lockouts (see the operation). `/health`, `/health/ready`, `/api/v1/events`, `/mcp`, `/metrics`, `/api/v1/account/*` and login are outside this limiter.

**Lists** (`/domains`, `/accounts`, `/aliases`) return plain JSON arrays with the unpaginated size in the `X-Total-Count` header; `limit` 1-1000 (default 100) and `offset` are validated (400).

**Message ids.** The REST message id is the blob content hash. When byte-identical copies exist (same mail in two folders or twice in one), list results report each copy as `<hash>_<uid>_<base64url(mailbox)>`, which addresses exactly one (folder, uid) entry for delete/flags/move/get; a hash held once keeps its plain id.

Generated from `openapi.yaml` (OpenAPI 3.0.3, the primary spec); the admin-only listener (`http://127.0.0.1:8443`) serves the admin routes with the same paths. Cookie auth (`jwt`) cannot be expressed in Swagger 2.0 and is described in prose only; use `openapi.yaml` for the full model.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrator operations (domains, accounts, aliases, queue, limits, keys)

tags.name: Mail
tags.description: Webmail endpoints operating on the caller's own mailboxes

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: `Bearer <JWT>` from POST /api/v1/auth/login. An HttpOnly `jwt` cookie is accepted as an alternative (not expressible in Swagger 2.0).

Error.description: Error body used by every JSON handler of the main API. Some cluster/health/SSE paths answer with plain text instead (noted per operation).

AdminListenerError.description: Error body of the authentication / admin-guard layer of the admin-only listener (port 8443).

totp_code.description: Required when the account has TOTP enabled.

token.description: JWT (HS256). Returned in the body only for non-browser clients (User-Agent without Mozilla/Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge) or when an Authorization header was sent; browsers receive it solely via the HttpOnly `jwt` cookie.

dkim_selector.description: Present once a DKIM key exists (always "default" for API-created domains).

name.description: Lower-cased; validated as a domain name.

DomainUpdate.description: Omitted fields keep their stored value.

password.description: Must satisfy the password policy (max 128 characters).
Admin reset of ANOTHER account's password (403 for your own: use /api/v1/account/password). Revokes that account's sessions.

is_admin.description: Changing it requires current_admin_password; an admin cannot change their own admin flag.

current_admin_password.description: Acting admin's password; required when is_admin changes.

AccountUpdate.description: Omitted fields keep their stored value; unknown fields are rejected (400).

status.description: pending, sending, failed (delivered/bounced entries are never listed; they can still be fetched by id).

RateLimitConfig.description: Mail-protocol (SMTP/IMAP) rate limits managed at runtime; unrelated to the HTTP API limiter. All fields are required on PUT.

id.description: Message id. Plain content hash, or `<hash>_<uid>_<base64url(mailbox)>` when identical bytes exist more than once for the account (see tag description).

Mail.description: `cc`/`bcc` are only present on single-message reads of the Drafts folder.

SendMailRequest.description: to+cc+bcc <= 100 addresses, each a bare addr-spec. Unknown fields are rejected (400). No attachment support.

folder.description: Optional; all mailboxes searched when omitted.

FlagsRequest.description: id + ids up to 1000 distinct ids; add + remove between 1 and 16 entries (flag names case-insensitive, leading backslash optional).

id.description: Existing draft to replace (required for PUT).

from.description: Source folder (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, spam or a mailbox name).

MoveRequest.description: id + ids up to 1000 distinct ids. Unknown fields are ignored.

start_date.description: RFC 3339. An unparsable value is silently ignored.

end_date.description: RFC 3339; must not be before start_date.

send_interval.description: Hours between replies to the same sender. Required on PUT (0/omitted is rejected).

field.description: from, to, subject, body or header

type.description: move, copy, delete, markRead, markSpam, forward, flag

FilterUpdate.description: Omitted/empty fields keep their stored value.

Health.description: Shape depends on wiring. With the health monitor (normal server start): status/timestamp/version/checks/system. Without it: status plus database/queue/storage strings. 503 when unhealthy.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not supported on this path; `Allow` lists the supported ones

post.description: Rate limited per IP (failure lockout, default 5 failures, 5 min doubling to 60 min; `security.max_login_attempts`) and per (IP, account) (5 failures / 5 min). Failed TOTP attempts per account lock after 5 failures for 5 minutes. Sets the `jwt` cookie.

401.description: `invalid credentials` (bad password, unknown or disabled account), `TOTP code required`, `invalid TOTP code` or `TOTP code already used`

post.description: Revokes the presented token(s) and clears the cookie. `DELETE` is accepted as an alias of POST.
Revokes the presented token(s) and issues a new one (also replaces the cookie for cookie sessions). The request must still carry `Content-Type: application/json` (CSRF layer), body is ignored.

Shares the per-(IP, account) failed-password budget with login (5 failures / 5 min). Revokes all existing sessions of the account and returns a replacement (cookie, plus `token`/`expiresIn` for non-browser clients).
Generates and stores (encrypted) a new secret; not active until verified.
Enables TOTP; each time step can be used once. Revokes sessions and returns a replacement session like a password change.

401.description: `invalid TOTP code` or `TOTP code already used`

post.description: When TOTP is enabled the body must carry a current valid `code` (400 `current TOTP code required to disable 2FA`, 401 invalid/used, 429 after 5 failures).

put.description: Empty `forward_to` disables forwarding and clears keep_copy. `forward_copy` is accepted as a legacy alias of `keep_copy`.

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Sorted by name.

post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Generates a 2048-bit DKIM key (selector `default`).

put.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Deactivating a domain that still has accounts is a 409.

delete.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Cascades to the domain's accounts and mailbox data. 409 when it holds the last active administrator; 500 if mailbox purge partly failed (retry DELETE per account).

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Sorted by address.

post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). 400 for a bad address, weak password or unknown domain; 409 for a duplicate account or when the domain's `max_accounts` is reached.

put.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Partial update. 409 `cannot demote or deactivate the last active administrator`. A password reset, disable or demotion revokes the account's sessions.

delete.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Removes the account and purges its mailbox data. 409 `cannot delete the last active administrator` (also when an admin deletes their own account). Admin callers need no password. The handler also contains a branch for a non-admin deleting their own account with `{"password": ...}` in the body (400 `password is required...`, 403 `password is incorrect`, 429 shared password budget), but the route is wrapped in the admin guard, so non-admins always receive 403 before reaching it.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Only consulted for non-admin callers (unreachable through the router).

post.summary: Start TOTP enrolment for an account
post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). An admin may act on non-admin accounts only; acting on an admin account (other than your own) is 403.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrolment for an account
post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). An admin may act on non-admin accounts only; acting on an admin account (other than your own) is 403.
**Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). An admin may act on non-admin accounts only; acting on an admin account (other than your own) is 403.
**Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). 400 for unknown alias domain or unknown target account; 409 for a duplicate or an alias that clashes with a mailbox.

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Oldest first; delivered and bounced entries are omitted. Equivalent to `/api/v1/queue`.

post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). POST on the entry itself (there is no /retry suffix). 409 when the entry is sending, delivered or bounced.

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Oldest first; delivered and bounced entries are omitted. Equivalent to `/api/v1/admin/queue`.

post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). POST on the entry itself (there is no /retry suffix). 409 when the entry is sending, delivered or bounced.

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Counters grouped by subsystem (smtp, imap, delivery, spam, api, caches, ...) plus a `queue` object with pending/sending/failed/delivered/bounced/total. Free-form.

get.summary: List accounts with active vacation replies

post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Old tokens stay valid until they expire (at most 5 key versions are kept).

get.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Cluster endpoints answer errors as plain text (`text/plain`), not the JSON error body. When clustering is off returns `{enabled:false,status:"disabled",instances:[]}`.
**Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Cluster endpoints answer errors as plain text (`text/plain`), not the JSON error body.

post.summary: Release leadership to a healthy peer
post.description: **Admin only** (403 `{"error":"admin access required"}` otherwise). Cluster endpoints answer errors as plain text (`text/plain`), not the JSON error body.

post.description: Queues for delivery (when the queue is wired) and stores in Sent. Body limit about 26 MB; an oversized request fails JSON decoding (400).

id.description: Id of the stored Sent copy

delete.description: Permanently removes the message (not a move to Trash). No error is returned when the id matches nothing. A copy-qualified id removes exactly that copy. The id may also be sent as a form value with POST.

post.description: Failures after the plan stage (404/500) include the ids already updated in an `updated` array next to `error`.
The id changes whenever content changes (ids are content hashes).
Keeps flags (IMAP MOVE semantics). 409 when a plain-id message already exists in the destination. A mid-way failure answers 500 with `{error, moved}`.

get.description: Authenticated with the cookie or `Authorization: Bearer` (also `X-Auth-Token`). Not subject to the API rate limit. Events: `connected`, `heartbeat` (every 30 s; the token is re-validated on each beat and the stream is closed once invalid), `new_mail`, `expunge`, `flags_changed`, `folder_update`. At most 5 concurrent streams per user (the oldest is dropped). Errors are plain text.

post.description: Requires a valid API JWT (cookie or Bearer). Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get. Protocol errors are JSON-RPC error objects; additionally, when MCP-specific tokens are configured they are checked against the same Authorization header.

400.description: Parse / invalid request / unknown method (JSON-RPC error)

get.description: Public, exempt from rate limiting. Also served (simplified) on the admin listener.

Domain comes from `?emailaddress=` or an `autoconfig.<domain>` Host. Advertises IMAP 993 and SMTP 465 (SSL) on `mail.<domain>`.
